in_arabic.name: علي
in_arabic.long_meaning: The name 'Ali means 'Exalted, Noble'. It is derived from the Arabic root 'al-' meaning 'high, exalted, or noble'. This name is often used in Islamic contexts to refer to important figures such as 'Ali ibn Abi Talib, the fourth rightly-guided caliph, and a cousin and son-in-law of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh).
